title: Alpaca closes are journal-closed by the position-snapshot reconciler / stuck watchdog with an INFERRED exit reason; read the filled bracket leg (broker_order_id, nested=true) to close with the broker's own reason, price and time
clears_when: PR #25240 merged (git merge-base --is-ancestor <its merge sha> origin/main), then the row moves to landed_unproven with observe = the next real Alpaca bracket-leg close shows notes.closed_by=broker_leg_fill and exit_price == the leg's filled_avg_price (diag journal)
note: Filed by lane ALPACA-LIVE-MECHANICS 2026-11-06. MEASURED (/api/diag/journal trades limit=300 + /api/diag/alpaca_order_history, alpaca_paper after 2026-11-02 and alpaca_live after 2026-09-01): every Alpaca close in the window (4 alpaca_paper closes 6840 QLD tp, 6877 SCHA sl, 6908 SLV sl, 6920 SLV sl, plus alpaca_live 6097 IAUM sl on 09-28) was written by position_snapshot_reconciler or stuck_strategy_watchdog ('integration has no per-order status reader (non-Bybit)', src/runtime/order_monitor.py ~4806). The sl/tp label matched the leg that filled at the broker in each case, but it came from exit_reason_source=price_vs_pkg_bracket, and pnl from local_compute. The broker read already exists (src/units/accounts/clients.py account_alpaca_order_history, nested legs with filled_avg_price/filled_at). Fix: when an Alpaca row's position is flat, read its parent order by broker_order_id, take the filled leg as exit reason/price/time (exit_reason_source broker_leg_fill), and fall back to the current inference only if the read fails. Re-entry test: the next Alpaca close has closed_by naming the broker leg read and exit_price == the leg's filled_avg_price. Pairs with the entry-fill fix in the ALPACA-LIVE-MECHANICS PR. 2026-11-06 15:00Z FRESH EVIDENCE (manager 1106a, journal read 15:03Z): ml_entry max_hold closes at 15:00Z: alpaca_paper trades 6918 SPY, 6919 QQQ, 6923 TQQQ closed exit_reason=max_hold with exit_price NULL and pnl NULL (ungradeable); bybit_portfolio mirror 6928 BTC exit 75425.9 pnl NULL. bybit_2 real-money 6927 BTC clean (exit 75459.8, pnl +0.495). Fix must fill exit_price/pnl from the broker fill for every Alpaca close and the bybit_portfolio mirror, and backfill these four. 2026-11-06 lane SOAK-PING-FOLLOWUP: soak SOAK-stage1-alpaca_paper-ml_entry mechanical_fail (16Z) is trade 6926 IAUM, same cohort as 6918/6919/6923 (opened 2026-11-05 16:02-16:04Z). The three max_hold closes landed 15:00-15:01Z with exit/pnl from the broker; 6926 was instead flat-closed 15:03:10Z by position_snapshot_reconciler as exchange_flat_reconciled (notes: exit_reason_source=unresolved, exit_price_source=exchange_fill, pnl_source=local_compute). MEASURED from the journal read; the actual order history for IAUM was not pulled. It is THIS row's path (reconciler inferring a max_hold flat), not a new one. #23822 (deferred-close retry, deployed 16:51Z) postdates 6926 by ~1h48m so it neither caused nor fixed it; test it on the next max_hold wave (2026-11-07 ~15:00Z): the close should carry exit_reason=max_hold, not exchange_flat_reconciled. The grader correctly keeps this a fault (reconciler close is a bug by contract; not pending). 2026-11-12 lane JOURNAL-TRUTH: PR #25240 (Tier 2, landing hold, manager lands). New sweep _sweep_alpaca_close_from_broker_leg reads /v2/orders/{broker_order_id}?nested=true right after the reverse reconciler; a single exit-side leg that filled the whole position sets exit_reason sl/tp, exit_price = filled_avg_price, closed_at = filled_at, pnl; stamps broker_leg_fill (MEASURED); otherwise notes.broker_leg_read records why and the old inference stands. MEASURED: 7011/7012 stop legs filled 14:33:31Z/14:33:39Z, journal closed 14:36:00Z. alpaca_paper broker history before 2026-11-09 19:42Z returns 404 (INFERRED: paper account reset), so older rows cannot be backfilled. Not covered: a max_hold close the reconciler flat-closes (6926 shape) has no filled bracket leg and keeps the inference; the bybit_portfolio NULL-exit max_hold item is not in this PR. Done-condition: the next real Alpaca bracket-leg close carries closed_by=broker_leg_fill with exit_price == the leg filled_avg_price (merged != deployed != observed: none yet). FINDING 2026-11-15 (AM-OPS, ENTRY-FILL-BIAS-30D, record comms/research/entry_fill_bias/2026-11-15.json, PR #26166): of 27 alpaca_paper closes since 10-16, all 27 carry a broker_order_id, but /api/diag/alpaca_order_history?order_ids=... answers read_state not_found for 16 (example ids 44bd08cf-a627-4a19-b5c4-a52e1632f66b, 5b61d535-0d0e-4b66-974f-1b5fe3d6160a); the other 11 read order_read / filled. So for ~60% of alpaca_paper rows the stored id is not an order Alpaca knows: this row's close truth (read the filled bracket leg by broker_order_id) and any filled_avg_price read fail on them. Next step: compare those 16 ids with notes.trade_id / client_order_id, and check whether they predate a paper-account reset.
